item.subject: science
item.stem: Meena's mother gives her a mixture containing sand, common salt and water. Meena wants to collect each part separately. Which statement is correct?

options.A: One single method is enough because every mixture can be separated completely if the method is done carefully.
options.B: She needs more than one method in a sequence: filter to get the sand, then evaporate the water to get the salt.
options.C: Filtering the mixture once will collect the sand, the salt and the water separately at the same time.
options.D: Evaporating the water first will give pure salt, leaving no need for any other step.
